description: This file defines a data class SmsData used to represent SMS message information in the project. It contains fields such as id, groupId, clientId, staffId, status, mobileNo, message, providerId, and campaignName. The class is immutable, with a static factory method for instantiation, and uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.description: Immutable data object representing an SMS message, with various optional fields related to message metadata.
